name: UniFlow
summary: UniFlow is a shared workspace for team conversations and follow-through. It keeps channels, reviewed decisions, ideas, tasks, goals and leads in one environment, so the next step stays connected to the discussion behind it.
positioning: Work with the context behind the task.
disclosure: Available for guided evaluation. Some AI and advanced workspace screens use sample behaviour; external AI providers need configuration. A demo is not proof of production readiness.
audience: Growing teams whose ideas get lost in chat

workflow.description: Accept or reject proposed decisions and ideas.
Give a task an owner, status and priority.
Return to stored context when the question comes back.

differentiators: Conversation → reviewed record → task continuity in one environment
Explicit accept or reject review — proposals are never committed automatically
Shared provenance: records keep their relationships to the conversation behind them

architecture.boundary: Optional external AI providers are configured and policy-gated; device push delivery remains unfinished.

evidence.summary: A local 12-stage core-loop exercise covered the areas below. It used deterministic sample AI. It validates a local path — not real-model quality, production scale, customer results or independent certification.

faqs.question: Is this another team chat app?
faqs.answer: Team chat is one part of it. The product also holds reviewed decisions, ideas, tasks, goals and leads. Its main value is keeping discussion and follow-through close together.

faqs.question: Can we replace every tool with UniFlow?
faqs.answer: That has not been established. Start with one workflow and check the features, integrations and access controls your team needs.

faqs.question: Can we use it for meetings?
faqs.answer: Meeting records and lifecycle actions exist. Live meeting media has not been verified.

faqs.question: Will reminders arrive on our phones?
faqs.answer: The in-app notification inbox is implemented. External device push delivery is not ready in the reviewed source.

faqs.question: Does AI automatically make decisions for us?
faqs.answer: No. Proposed insights need review. The default evaluation uses sample AI output; a real provider must be configured and checked separately.

faqs.question: Can we use our own AI provider?
faqs.answer: Provider routing and privacy rules exist. Availability and quality depend on configuration and separate validation.

faqs.question: Is the knowledge graph live?
faqs.answer: The backend stores relationships. The current visual graph screen uses hand-authored sample nodes and should be shown as a concept preview.

faqs.question: What should we test first?
faqs.answer: Use a single project: create a channel, discuss a topic, review a decision and create a task. Check that the team can find the context again.

faqs.question: Is there a public price?
faqs.answer: No public price is listed. Ask for a written scope and price for your requirements before making a purchase decision.

faqs.question: Is UniFlow ready for production use?
faqs.answer: UniFlow is available for guided evaluation. Some AI and advanced workspace screens use sample behaviour; external AI providers need configuration. A demo is not proof of production readiness.

faqs.question: What should we bring to a walkthrough?
faqs.answer: One anonymised example of the work, the people who handle it and the result you need. Avoid passwords, account keys, private customer records or employee details.
